description: This file defines the RetryableMalformedResponseParser class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling S3 responses. The class converts malformed responses into retryable errors, aiding in robust error handling for AWS S3 API interactions.

classes.name: RetryableMalformedResponseParser
classes.description: A parser class that handles malformed responses from AWS S3, converting them into retryable exceptions to improve error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser callable and exception class used for error handling.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes the parser on the command and response, converting parsing exceptions into retryable AWS exceptions.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Delegates parsing of a member from a stream to the internal parser, used for processing streamed response data.
